messages:
chris: Quick sync: follow-ups from last night's routing+tls retry spike. I captured proposed owners below. Please confirm or reassign.
lara: TLDR: a route selection bug caused cross-region fallbacks when cert validation timed out, which multiplied client retries. Need short-term mitigations + longer-term detection.
meena: I'll take immediate mitigation: add a 3-attempt per-request local circuit breaker in the runtime to stop retry storms. Plan: feature flag + 5% canary, rollback toggle. ETA 2026-04-02.
zack: I'll own the root cause fix in the routing service (ensuring endpoint affinity unless explicit failover). ETA 2026-04-09.
chris: meena and zack coordinate on how the circuit-breaker interacts with routing affinity; don't kill correctness.
meena: noted. Proposed CLI test for local simulation: 
```bash
# simulate 1000 requests with 30% cert timeouts
python tools/simulate_requests.py --rate 200 --timeout-rate 0.3 --out results.json
```
I'll add this to the PR.
ops-bot: system: observed pattern: ttl_delta > 200s between edges; sample:
"2026-03-22T02:12:09Z WARN DNS: edge=us-west observed_TTL=2s expected=300s zone=redwood.ai"
ops-bot: created incident task: INC-7890, linked to tracker.
lara: DNS follow-up: meena, can you add a probe that runs dig + compares authoritative TTL vs edge cache TTL every 10m? If mismatch > 60s, page pager on-call.
meena: yes. I'll add probe + dashboard tile. ETA 2026-04-04.
zack: registrar note: registrar rate-limits caused delayed updates during the spike; ashley should own registrar escalation. @ashley -- can you confirm?
ashley: (joined) I can take registrar escalation. I'll open a support ticket and share the reference by EOD 2026-03-25.
chris: Monitoring action: add a rolling metric "tls_handshake.fail_rate.region" and alert when >0.4% for 10m. Owner: lara, ETA 2026-04-01.
lara: On it. Will also wire this to the automated rollback hook that flips the routing to stable variant.
meena: Runbook: short doc in /runbooks/networking/routing-retry-storm.md with step-by-step mitigations + who to call (registrar, edge team). I'll author draft. ETA 2026-03-30.
chris: Summarize owners + dates:
- meena: local circuit-breaker + probe + runbook draft (2026-04-02 / 2026-04-04 / 2026-03-30)
- zack: routing service fix + tests (2026-04-09)
- ashley: registrar escalation + ticket (2026-03-25)
- lara: alert + metric + rollback wiring (2026-04-01)
- chris: coordinate postmortem additions and weekly network trends (start 2026-04-05)
Please react :white_check_mark: or reply with changes.
dev-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1299 (meena/circuit-breaker).
meena: PR link + test logs will be posted here when CI finishes.
lara: :white_check_mark: all good from me.
chris: Thanks team. I'll add these to the postmortem doc and mark INC-7890 with owners. We'll reconvene on 2026-04-06 for a short check-in.
